verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI documents a real-time monitoring dashboard with live system metrics and browser pool visibility, which covers the job-performance monitoring part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows built-in data-quality validation or failure alerting, and community commentary notes users must build their own quality gates. The on_state_change callbacks are a developer building block, not an alerting feature, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: data-quality validation, failure alerts/notifications, and in-depth docs or hands-on corroboration of the monitoring dashboard.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can monitor job performance, validate data quality, and receive alerts when something fails

citations.quote: Real-time Monitoring Dashboard with live system metrics and browser pool visibility
